attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: full_article_publishing_pipeline
steps:
  - id: search_google_drive
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/google-drive/search"
      query:
        folder: "pending_articles"
        mime_type: "application/pdf"
    output: raw_drive_results

  - id: validate_drive_results
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_drive_results
      schema: drive_search_results_schema
    output: validated_drive_results

  - id: loop_pdf_files
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: validated_drive_results
      step: download_pdf_binary

  - id: download_pdf_binary
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/google-drive/download"
      file_id_from: validated_drive_results
    output: raw_pdf_binary

  - id: validate_pdf_binary
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_pdf_binary
      schema: pdf_binary_schema
    output: validated_pdf_binary

  - id: send_to_ai_vision
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      url: "/api/ai-vision/extract"
      method: "POST"
      input: validated_pdf_binary
      content_type: "application/pdf"
    output: raw_ai_response

  - id: authenticate_publisher
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "publisher"
    output: auth_result

  - id: validate_ai_response
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_ai_response
      schema: ai_extraction_response_schema
    output: validated_ai_response

  - id: check_multiple_articles
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "es_multiple_check"
      condition: "validated_ai_response.es_multiple == true"
      input: validated_ai_response
    output: multiple_check_result

  - id: route_multiple_or_single
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "multiple_check_result.is_multiple == true"
      true_step: loop_multiple_reviews
      false_step: normalise_title

  - id: loop_multiple_reviews
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: validated_ai_response
      collection_field: "reviews"
      step: normalise_title

  - id: normalise_title
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_ai_response
      mapping:
        normalised_title: "trim_lowercase(article.title)"
        raw_article: "article"
    output: normalised_article

  - id: fetch_category_spreadsheet
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/google-drive/spreadsheet"
      spreadsheet: "category_mapping.xlsx"
    output: raw_category_sheet

  - id: validate_category_sheet
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_category_sheet
      schema: category_spreadsheet_schema
    output: validated_category_sheet

  - id: match_category
    op: filter_records
    params:
      input: validated_category_sheet
      condition: "record.normalised_title == normalised_article.normalised_title"
    output: category_match_results

  - id: evaluate_category_match
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "category_match_or_default"
      condition: "category_match_results.count > 0"
      default_category: "uncategorised"
      input: category_match_results
    output: resolved_category

  - id: flag_no_match
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "resolved_category.is_default == true"
      true_step: notify_review_team
      false_step: convert_content_to_html

  - id: notify_review_team
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: normalised_article
      recipient: "review_team"
      message: "Article has no Excel category match. Publishing with default category."
      channel: "email"

  - id: convert_content_to_html
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: normalised_article
      mapping:
        html_body: "convert_to_html(article.content)"
        is_interview: "article.format == 'interview'"
        interview_html: "convert_interview_to_html(article.content)"
    output: html_content

  - id: lookup_cms_metadata
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/cms/lookup"
      queries:
        author: "normalised_article.raw_article.author"
        category: "resolved_category.category_name"
        magazine: "normalised_article.raw_article.magazine_issue"
    output: raw_cms_metadata

  - id: validate_cms_metadata
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_cms_metadata
      schema: cms_metadata_schema
    output: validated_cms_metadata

  - id: merge_article_data
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: html_content
      secondary: validated_cms_metadata
      key: "article_id"
    output: merged_article_data

  - id: retrieve_csrf_token
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/cms/csrf-token"
      method: "GET"
    output: raw_csrf_token

  - id: validate_csrf_token
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_csrf_token
      schema: csrf_token_schema
    output: validated_csrf_token

  - id: prepare_paragraph_payload
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: merged_article_data
      mapping:
        paragraphs: "split_html_to_paragraphs(html_body)"
        csrf_token: "validated_csrf_token.token"
        author_id: "cms_metadata.author_id"
    output: paragraph_payload

  - id: create_paragraph_blocks
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      url: "/api/cms/entity/paragraph"
      method: "POST"
      input: paragraph_payload
      headers:
        X-CSRF-Token: "validated_csrf_token.token"
    output: raw_paragraph_response

  - id: validate_paragraph_response
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_paragraph_response
      schema: paragraph_entity_response_schema
    output: validated_paragraph_refs

  - id: prepare_article_node_payload
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: merged_article_data
      mapping:
        title: "raw_article.title"
        body_paragraphs: "validated_paragraph_refs.paragraph_ids"
        author_id: "cms_metadata.author_id"
        category_uuid: "cms_metadata.category_uuid"
        magazine_uuid: "cms_metadata.magazine_uuid"
        csrf_token: "validated_csrf_token.token"
    output: article_node_payload

  - id: create_article_node
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      url: "/api/cms/node/article"
      method: "POST"
      input: article_node_payload
      headers:
        X-CSRF-Token: "validated_csrf_token.token"
    output: raw_article_node_response

  - id: validate_article_node_response
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_article_node_response
      schema: article_node_response_schema
    output: validated_article_node

  - id: handle_publish_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      step: create_article_node
      on_error: retry_article_publish

  - id: retry_article_publish
    op: retry_step
    params:
      step: create_article_node
      max_retries: 3
      backoff: "exponential"

  - id: log_published_article
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: validated_article_node
      event: "article_published"
      details
